questions.question: What further evolution would grow from this companion’s established identity, and how would the player reach it?

description:
The existing Dark stage after Poochyena, reached at level 18. Snarl on evolution adds pressure against special attackers. Pack coordination belongs to its stock species characterization; Pookie’s loyalty and unease at the pier remain the history of one individual. A further custom stage is intended but undesigned.

Proposed companion behavior: a familiar travel group can coordinate through pauses, glances and waiting at a fork, extending the stock species’ pack coordination without assigning every individual a rigid master. A larger dog changes the distance at which strangers are comfortable approaching. Let an ordinary wary traveler ask for space and receive it; reassurance need not be demonstrated by defeating them in battle.
